## Readiness review (round 1): Needs answers Round: 1 · Questions: 1 · Assumptions: 2 · Suggested edits: 1 · Spec commit: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb · Harness version: 2026.10.06.3 **Check these first:** none ### Questions #### Q-1: How many retries? - **Options:** (one per line) - (a) One retry: simplest. Scope: within the issue - (b) Three retries with backoff: matches the client. Scope: within the issue - (c) Configurable: adds a setting. Scope: adds a config key - **Edges:** a send that fails on the third retry is reported failed, not retried again; two concurrent sends retry independently; the evidence is `test/send.test.ts`. - **Recommendation:** (b), because the client does three. - **Reply:** `Decision r1/Q-1: (b)` ### Assumptions | ID | Assumption | Basis | Makes stale | To correct | |---|---|---|---|---| | A-1 | The agent puts the retry loop in `src/send.ts` (suggestion) | convention | `docs/send.md:12`
`test/send.test.ts:40` ("sends once") | `Decision r1/A-1: ` | | A-2 | Errors are logged once | ADR-2 | nothing | `Decision r1/A-2: ` | ### Suggested edits to the issue #### E-1: add a verification section Before: ```text - [ ] A failed send is retried. ``` After: ```text - [ ] A failed send is retried up to three times. ## Verification - Run the send tests. ``` - **Reply:** `Decision r1/E-1: accept` ### Reuse, dependencies and risks - **Reuse:** import `withBackoff` from `src/util/retry.ts:8`; move `isTransient` from `src/client.ts:40` to `src/util/errors.ts` and import it from both (adds owned path `src/util/errors.ts`) - **Dependencies:** none **Relied on:** `docs/adr/0002.md` "Logging"
